##### Effort

Just left of the model picker sits the effort picker, laid out and behaving the same way: a small ghost button reading the reasoning effort the next prompt goes to, "Low", "Medium", "High", or "Default", with a chevron, which opens a menu of the levels the harness in use can be told, "Default" first, ticked when chosen, which tells the harness no effort, so it uses its own.
Only a harness that takes a reasoning effort offers it: Codex, told with `--model-reasoning-effort low`, `medium`, or `high`. It applies, is remembered, and travels with a prompt the same way the model picker does: on every tab but Freeform, which always goes without one; remembered for the user per harness, as the [UserPreferencesScope](../../user-preferences/index.md#user-preferences-scope) says, starting at Default; a queued prompt, a resend, a Chain prompt's steps, and a message sent to a running task each keeping the effort they were first sent with; and the help text giving way to it as it does to the model picker. A level the harness refuses fails the run, saying so in the harness's own words. The notes, commit messages, and prompt titles are sent without an effort level, whatever is chosen.
